mapper.select: select id, token_hash, user_id, expire_time, invalidated from sys_normal_user_refresh_token where token_hash = #{tokenHash} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_normal_user_refresh_token (token_hash, user_id, expire_time, invalidated) values (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{expireTime}, #{invalidated})
mapper.update: update sys_normal_user_refresh_token set invalidated = 1, update_time = now() where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and invalidated = 0
